25.original: Deliver the carved wood earrings and the Ronkan lilybell to the girl with pigtails.

26.original: Deliver the engraven ring to Nymet.

48.original: Greetings, ally of Ronka. You have come at an opportune time. I am faced with a problem that I could use an outsider's assistance to solve.

49.original: Several days ago we sighted a young girl wandering the wood. We loosed warning arrows, and she fled back whence she came. However, she dropped these earrings in her haste.

50.original: I bear no ill will toward her, so I would like to return them, but I cannot leave. If it is not too much trouble, could you bring them to their owner?

51.original: As a sign of apology, I would like to affix a Ronkan lilybell to the earrings. They can be found growing in the woods of Yx'Maja. When you are done, please make your way to Slitherbough and find her. I believe she wore her hair in pigtails.

52.original: I apologize for requesting such a menial task from you, but as you know I have little recourse. I simply wish to put her heart at ease.

53.original: When you have affixed the earrings with the lilybell, please bring them to the young lady in Slitherbough. I pray this sets her heart at ease.

54.original: What's this? Earrings? They aren't mine, although they are pretty. If it was a necklace I might've been tempted to lie, tee hee.

55.original: Earrings? Mine have been firmly attached to my ears as far as I know. A friend of mine was lamenting over something she had lost, however...

56.original: Hmm? A pair of earrings? It just so happens I lost my own while in the woods some time ago...

57.original: You didn't! You found them! And the lilybell is a masterful touch!

58.original: That Viis asked you to do this? I...I suppose she didn't mean me harm after all...

59.original: It is as Master Matoya said. They uphold their duty as the wood's protectors with grave severity. They only reacted as they should have.

60.original: Please, give this ring to the one who sent you. Tell her I apologize for my rudeness, and will be more careful when next I go into the woods.

61.original: Please give my ring to the Viis by way of apology. It's the least I can give after I encroached upon their sacred space.

62.original: You have returned. Did you find the girl?

63.original: I see. She is kind as well as wise. I shall hang this ring from my neck as a keepsake, to remind me of her. You have my gratitude for everything you have done.
